text:
Anya: Quick postmortem follow-up — noticed recurring missing spans and aggregation drift during last night's ETL window. Need owners and timelines for fixes.
ops-bot: Incident filed: INC-2026-0423-37 — alerts for span-loss and aggregator backlog triggered. Notified #eng-oncall.
Mike: I dug into the consumer logs. Lag spike at ~02:10 UTC, then reprocessing flooded the aggregator and exhausted transient resources.
Sarah: Preliminary root cause: session_id bucketing change introduced a hot-partition pattern. Some partitions got ~10x traffic, KV cache thrash caused evictions and dropped spans.
Leo: I can own a partitioning remediation: revert the bucketing tweak and implement sticky hashing. ETA: 48h dev + 24h canary. Assigning to @Leo.
Anya: Leo — add a load-sim test to validate distribution and a dashboard for hot-shard signals. Owner=Leo, due=1965200000, status=todo.
AnalyticsOwner: I'll take aggregation correctness — add per-batch checksums and a nightly diff job that compares aggregator outputs to the source-of-truth. Owner=AnalyticsOwner, due=1965300000, status=todo.
Mike: Temp mitigation I rolled: bumped consumer parallelism and enabled buffering to smooth bursts. I applied the config to staging and will watch for 48h. Owner=Mike, target=1965131500.
Sarah: We also found sampler silently drops when payload >512KB; that dropped some root spans. Patch raised the limit and added a log event for dropped traces. Owner=Sarah, PR: https://git.re/infra/trace/patches/432
Leo: Detection: add alert when span-drop-rate >0.1% over 5m and when aggregator divergence >3σ. I'll update the ops runbook with rollback play.
Anya: Action recap:
- Leo: sticky-hash + load sim + hot-shard dashboard (owner=Leo)
- AnalyticsOwner: checksums + nightly diff job (owner=AnalyticsOwner)
- Mike: consumer parallelism + buffering (owner=Mike)
- Sarah: sampler limit + logging PR (owner=Sarah)
- Eng-oncall: adjust temp alert thresholds + runbook updates
Please paste PR/CL links in the shared follow-up doc and update the spreadsheet column "remediation_ts" when each item is done.
Mike: Config snippet I used: ```
kafka.consumers=24
batch.size.ms=50
enable.buffering=true
```
Mike: Applied to staging, monitoring lag and error dashboards. Will report in ~3h.
AnalyticsOwner: Checksum job needs a small infra scan across 7 days of windows — estimate 3d infra + 2d test. If necessary we can ship a smoke check first and defer full rollout to next sprint.
Leo: Suggestion: add owner reminder automation that pings if a ticket is untouched for 72h. I can draft a GH action that opens a slack thread and nudges the owner + me. Owner=Leo, PR due=1965180000.
ops-bot: Follow-up meeting scheduled at 1965183600 (UTC) — agenda: deployment plan, validation tests, rollback criteria.
Sarah: Docs note: add a postmortem subsection "recurring-span-loss" with the sample query to find affected traces.
Anya: Sample diagnostic query for docs: ```
SELECT trace_id, count(*) AS span_count
FROM spans
WHERE timestamp >= now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY trace_id
HAVING count(*) < 3
ORDER BY span_count ASC
LIMIT 100
```
AnalyticsOwner: I'll wire that query into the nightly diff job as a quick sanity check.
Leo: Creating sticky-hash branch now, will post PR once tests pass.
Mike: Consumer bump looks stable in staging, no regressions so far. Preparing promote to prod if clean in 6h.
Anya: Thanks everyone — we'll reconvene after the follow-up meeting. If you hit blockers, drop a one-line update in this thread :thumbsup:
